// One-hot state transition: next state Y1 and Y3 independent of y[0]
// and y[2] fully independent of the other bits.
module TopModule(
    input  [5:0] y,
    input  w,
    output reg Y1,
    output reg Y3
);
    reg [5:0] yd;
    always @(*) yd = y ^ {6{w}};
    always @(*) begin
        case (y[5:0])
            6'b000001: begin Y1=1; Y3=0; end
            6'b000010: begin Y1=0; Y3=1; end
            6'b000100: begin Y1=0; Y3=0; end
            6'b001000: begin Y1=1; Y3=1; end
            6'b010000: begin Y1=1; Y3=0; end
            6'b100000: begin Y1=0; Y3=1; end
            default: begin Y1=0; Y3=0; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule
